candidates.change_summary: Remove the require overflow check, making depositsCount increment unconditionally.
Replace require condition with false to always revert, preventing any state change.
Delete the depositsCount increment statement entirely.
Replace the increment with decrement, changing depositsCount in opposite direction.

Remove the require check in withdrawAll so that the function no longer checks depositsCount overflow, but this change is equivalent—not a true mutant. Actually, deleting the onlyOwner modifier from withdrawAll would change behavior, so instead delete the entire modifier invocation from withdrawAll.
Replace withdraw(address(this).balance) with a call that sends balance to msg.sender instead of using the withdraw function, changing the observable effect on withdrawAll's state tracking.
Replace the argument to withdraw with a fixed value 0 so that withdrawAll no longer transfers the full balance of the contract, altering the observable balance change.
Replace the require check in onlyOwner with a check on a different address (e.g., a constant) so that the owner check is bypassed or altered, causing withdrawAll to execute for non-owner callers.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from withdraw(uint) so anyone can call it and drain funds.
Delete the require check inside onlyOwner so the modifier never reverts, letting anyone pass the guard.
Change onlyOwner to check msg.sender != owner, reversing the access control so owner is locked out and anyone else can call protected functions.
Change the recipient of the transfer from msg.sender to owner, so withdrawn funds go to the owner regardless of caller.
Replace the transfer amount with the full contract balance, ignoring the _value parameter and draining all funds.
